records.text: The SBI warrant read by Owens reports that Agent Mortensen, whose full identity and spelling remain unverified, reviewed UVU security video and discovered Robinson’s Challenger entering the Campus Drive parking structure at approximately 8:28 a.m.; Robinson then parked and exited.
